data.raw:
Missions at Bench Home Station (8):
--- Local Sector Survey [local_sector_survey] (exploration, difficulty 2) ---
Chart nearby star systems to update our navigation databases. Every system you visit helps.
From: Cartographer Mbeki (Navigation Database Maintainer)
"Our navigation charts are getting stale. If you visit 3 systems I haven't had recent data from, I'll pay for the navigation data."
Rewards: 2,500cr, +30 exploration XP, +15 navigation XP
Objectives:
  - Visit the Sirius system
    Target system: sirius
  - Visit the Node Alpha system
    Target system: node_alpha
  - Visit the Horizon system
    Target system: horizon
--- First Haul [first_haul] (equipment, difficulty 1) ---
The salvage yard foreman needs someone to tow in a wreck. A good way to learn the business.
From: Yard Foreman Dak (Salvage Yard Supervisor)
"New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. Use `view_market` to find one on the exchange and `buy` to purchase it, or craft one yourself. Then use `install_mod` to fit it in a utility slot. Once equipped, fly to a wreck, use `tow_wreck` to attach it, then haul it back here. Use `sell_wreck` to cash it in. Simple as that."
Rewards: 500cr, +25 salvaging XP
Objectives:
  - Sell 1 wreck at a salvage yard
--- Copper Requisition [copper_requisition] (mining, difficulty 1) ---
Copper ore is essential for electronics manufacturing. Mine a batch for the station workshops.
From: Workshop Lead Tanaka (Chief Fabricator)
"My workshop is backed up waiting on copper. If you can bring me 25 units of copper ore, I can get the production lines moving again."
Rewards: 1,800cr, +15 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 25 units of Copper Ore
--- Market Participation: Selling [market_participation_selling] (trading, difficulty 1) ---
List items for sale on the station exchange. Any items count toward the goal.
From: Exchange Operator Nkosi (Market Services)
"The exchange needs sellers as much as buyers. List some items for sale - at least 10 units of anything. Use the `create_sell_order` command to put items on the market. There's a small listing fee, but the returns are worth it when buyers come knocking."
Rewards: 1,000cr, +15 trading XP
Objectives:
  - Sell 10 units of any item on the exchange
--- Titanium Extraction Contract [titanium_extraction_contract] (mining, difficulty 3) ---
Titanium is in high demand for hull plating. Mine a batch from the local asteroid belts.
From: Procurement Agent Vasquez (Materials Acquisition)
"Titanium prices are through the roof and our suppliers can't keep up. Willing to pay premium rates for 20 units of titanium ore."
Rewards: 3,500cr, +25 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 20 units of Titanium Ore
--- Iron Supply Run [iron_supply_run] (mining, difficulty 1) ---
The station needs a steady supply of iron ore to maintain its infrastructure. Mine some and bring it back.
From: Quartermaster Osei (Station Supply Officer)
"We're running low on iron ore again. If you can mine 30 units and bring them back, I'll make it worth your while."
Rewards: 1,500cr, +15 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 30 units of Iron Ore
--- Market Participation: Buying [market_participation_buying] (trading, difficulty 1) ---
Place buy orders on the station exchange to learn how the market works. Any items count.
From: Exchange Operator Nkosi (Market Services)
"The exchange runs on supply and demand, and right now we need more demand. Place some buy orders - any items, any quantity, as long as you buy at least 10 units total. Use the `create_buy_order` command to place an order on the book. Your orders sit there until a seller fills them, or you can cancel."
Rewards: 1,000cr, +15 trading XP
Objectives:
  - Buy 10 units of any item on the exchange
--- Pirate Bounty [pirate_bounty] (combat, difficulty 2) ---
Hunt down a pirate threatening local shipping lanes. Any pirate will do - the station pays for confirmed kills.
From: Bounty Clerk Frost (Station Security Office)
"We've got pirates disrupting trade in the region and the station is posting bounties. Take one out and bring proof. Use the `attack` command when you find one - pirates tend to spawn in lawless systems with low police presence. Fair warning: they shoot back, so watch your hull."
Rewards: 2,000cr, +20 weapons XP
Objectives:
  - Kill 1 pirate

Missions at Bench Home Station (8):
--- Local Sector Survey [local_sector_survey] (exploration, difficulty 2) ---
Chart nearby star systems to update our navigation databases. Every system you visit helps.
From: Cartographer Mbeki (Navigation Database Maintainer)
"Our navigation charts are getting stale. If you visit 3 systems I haven't had recent data from, I'll pay for the navigation data."
Rewards: 2,500cr, +30 exploration XP, +15 navigation XP
Objectives:
  - Visit the Sirius system
    Target system: sirius
  - Visit the Node Alpha system
    Target system: node_alpha
  - Visit the Horizon system
    Target system: horizon
--- First Haul [first_haul] (equipment, difficulty 1) ---
The salvage yard foreman needs someone to tow in a wreck. A good way to learn the business.
From: Yard Foreman Dak (Salvage Yard Supervisor)
"New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. Use `view_market` to find one on the exchange and `buy` to purchase it, or craft one yourself. Then use `install_mod` to fit it in a utility slot. Once equipped, fly to a wreck, use `tow_wreck` to attach it, then haul it back here. Use `sell_wreck` to cash it in. Simple as that."
Rewards: 500cr, +25 salvaging XP
Objectives:
  - Sell 1 wreck at a salvage yard
--- Copper Requisition [copper_requisition] (mining, difficulty 1) ---
Copper ore is essential for electronics manufacturing. Mine a batch for the station workshops.
From: Workshop Lead Tanaka (Chief Fabricator)
"My workshop is backed up waiting on copper. If you can bring me 25 units of copper ore, I can get the production lines moving again."
Rewards: 1,800cr, +15 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 25 units of Copper Ore
--- Market Participation: Selling [market_participation_selling] (trading, difficulty 1) ---
List items for sale on the station exchange. Any items count toward the goal.
From: Exchange Operator Nkosi (Market Services)
"The exchange needs sellers as much as buyers. List some items for sale - at least 10 units of anything. Use the `create_sell_order` command to put items on the market. There's a small listing fee, but the returns are worth it when buyers come knocking."
Rewards: 1,000cr, +15 trading XP
Objectives:
  - Sell 10 units of any item on the exchange
--- Titanium Extraction Contract [titanium_extraction_contract] (mining, difficulty 3) ---
Titanium is in high demand for hull plating. Mine a batch from the local asteroid belts.
From: Procurement Agent Vasquez (Materials Acquisition)
"Titanium prices are through the roof and our suppliers can't keep up. Willing to pay premium rates for 20 units of titanium ore."
Rewards: 3,500cr, +25 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 20 units of Titanium Ore
--- Iron Supply Run [iron_supply_run] (mining, difficulty 1) ---
The station needs a steady supply of iron ore to maintain its infrastructure. Mine some and bring it back.

Chart nearby star systems to update our navigation databases. Every system you visit helps.

The salvage yard foreman needs someone to tow in a wreck. A good way to learn the business.
From: Yard Foreman Dak (Salvage Yard Supervisor)
"New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. Use `view_market` to find one on the exchange and `buy` to purchase it, or craft one yourself. Then use `install_mod` to fit it in a utility slot. Once equipped, fly to a wreck, use `tow_wreck` to attach it, then haul it back here. Use `sell_wreck` to cash it in. Simple as that."
Rewards: 500cr, +25 salvaging XP

Copper ore is essential for electronics manufacturing. Mine a batch for the station workshops.

"My workshop is backed up waiting on copper. If you can bring me 25 units of copper ore, I can get the production lines moving again."
Rewards: 1,800cr, +15 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 25 units of Copper Ore
--- Market Participation: Selling [market_participation_selling] (trading, difficulty 1) ---

"The exchange needs sellers as much as buyers. List some items for sale - at least 10 units of anything. Use the `create_sell_order` command to put items on the market. There's a small listing fee, but the returns are worth it when buyers come knocking."
Rewards: 1,000cr, +15 trading XP
Objectives:
  - Sell 10 units of any item on the exchange

"Titanium prices are through the roof and our suppliers can't keep up. Willing to pay premium rates for 20 units of titanium ore."

"New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. --- First Haul [first_haul] (equipment, difficulty 1) ---
The salvage yard foreman needs someone to tow in a wreck. A good way to learn the business.
From: Yard Foreman Dak (Salvage Yard Supervisor)
"New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. Use `view_market` to find one on the exchange and `buy` to purchase it, or craft one yourself. Then use `install_mod` to fit it in a utility slot. Once equipped, fly to a wreck, use `tow_wreck` to attach it, then haul it back here. Use `sell_wreck` to cash it in. Simple as that."

"My workshop is backed up waiting on copper. If you can bring me 25 units of copper ore, I can get the production lines moving again."

--- Local Sector Survey [local_sector_survey] (exploration, difficulty 2) ---
Chart nearby star systems to update our navigation databases. Every system you visit helps.
From: Cartographer Mbeki (Navigation Database Maintainer)
"Our navigation charts are getting stale. If you visit 3 systems I haven't had recent data from, I'll pay for the navigation data."
Rewards: 2,500cr, +30 exploration XP, +15 navigation XP
Objectives:
  - Visit the Sirius system
    Target system: sirius
  - Visit the Node Alpha system

  - Visit the Horizon system
    Target system: horizon
--- First Haul [first_haul] (equipment, difficulty 1) ---
The salvage yard foreman needs someone to tow in a wreck. A good way to learn the business.
From: Yard Foreman Dak (Salvage Yard Supervisor)
"New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. Use `view_market` to find one on the exchange and `buy` to purchase it, or craft one yourself. Then use `install_mod` to fit it in a utility slot. Once equipped, fly to a wreck, use `tow_wreck` to attach it, then haul it back here. Use `sell_wreck` to cash it in. Simple as that."
Rewards: 500cr, +25 salvaging XP
Objectives:
  - Sell 1 wreck at a salvage yard
--- Copper Requisition [copper_requisition] (mining, difficulty 1) ---
Copper ore is essential for electronics manufacturing. Mine a batch for the station workshops.
From: Workshop Lead Tanaka (Chief Fabricator)
"My workshop is backed up waiting on copper. If you can bring me 25 units of copper ore, I can get the production lines moving again."
Rewards: 1,800cr, +15 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 25 units of Copper Ore
--- Market Participation: Selling [market_participation_selling] (trading, difficulty 1) ---
List items for sale on the station exchange. Any items count toward the goal.
From: Exchange Operator Nkosi (Market Services)
"The exchange needs sellers as much as buyers. List some items for sale - at least 10 units of anything. Use the `create_sell_order` command to put items on the market. There's a small listing fee, but the returns are worth it when buyers come knocking."
Rewards: 1,000cr, +15 trading XP
Objectives:
  - Sell 10 units of any item on the exchange
--- Titanium Extraction Contract [titanium_extraction_contract] (mining, difficulty 3) ---
Titanium is in high demand for hull plating. Mine a batch from the local asteroid belts.
From: Procurement Agent Vasquez (Materials Acquisition)
"Titanium prices are through the roof and our suppliers can't keep up. Willing to pay premium rates for 20 units of titanium ore."
Rewards: 3,500cr, +25 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 20 units of Titanium Ore

Missions at Bench Home Station (8):
--- Local Sector Survey [local_sector_survey] (exploration, difficulty 2) ---
Chart nearby star systems to update our navigation databases. Every system you visit helps.
From: Cartographer Mbeki (Navigation Database Maintainer)
"Our navigation charts are getting stale. If you visit 3 systems I haven't had recent data from, I'll pay for the navigation data."
Rewards: 2,500cr, +30 exploration XP, +15 navigation XP
Objectives:
  - Visit the Sirius system
    Target system: sirius
  - Visit the Node Alpha system
    Target system: node_alpha
  - Visit the Horizon system
    Target system: horizon
--- First Haul [first_haul] (equipment, difficulty 1) ---
The salvage yard foreman needs someone to tow in a wreck. A good way to learn the business.
From: Yard Foreman Dak (Salvage Yard Supervisor)
"New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. Use `view_market` to find one on the exchange and `buy` to purchase it, or craft one yourself. Then use `install_mod` to fit it in a utility slot. Once equipped, fly to a wreck, use `tow_wreck` to attach it, then haul it back here. Use `sell_wreck` to cash it in. Simple as that."
Rewards: 500cr, +25 salvaging XP
Objectives:
  - Sell 1 wreck at a salvage yard
--- Copper Requisition [copper_requisition] (mining, difficulty 1) ---
Copper ore is essential for electronics manufacturing. Mine a batch for the station workshops.
From: Workshop Lead Tanaka (Chief Fabricator)
"My workshop is backed up waiting on copper. If you can bring me 25 units of copper ore, I can get the production lines moving again."
Rewards: 1,800cr, +15 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 25 units of Copper Ore
--- Market Participation: Selling [market_participation_selling] (trading, difficulty 1) ---
List items for sale on the station exchange. Any items count toward the goal.
From: Exchange Operator Nkosi (Market Services)
"The exchange needs sellers as much as buyers. List some items for sale - at least 10 units of anything. Use the `create_sell_order` command to put items on the market. There's a small listing fee, but the returns are worth it when buyers come knocking."
Rewards: 1,000cr, +15 trading XP
Objectives:
  - Sell 10 units of any item on the exchange
--- Titanium Extraction Contract [titanium_extraction_contract] (mining, difficulty 3) ---
Titanium is in high demand for hull plating. Mine a batch from the local asteroid belts.
From: Procurement Agent Vasquez (Materials Acquisition)
"Titanium prices are through the roof and our suppliers can't keep up. Willing to pay premium rates for 20 units of titanium ore."
Rewards: 3,500cr, +25 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 20 units of Titanium Ore

"New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. The salvage yard foreman needs someone to tow in a wreck. A good way to learn the business.
From: Yard Foreman Dak (Salvage Yard Supervisor)
"New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. Use `view_market` to find one on the exchange and `buy` to purchase it, or craft one yourself. Then use `install_mod` to fit it in a utility slot. Once equipped, fly to a wreck, use `tow_wreck` to attach it, then haul it back here. Use `sell_wreck` to cash it in. Simple as that."

Chart nearby star systems to update our navigation databases. Every system you visit helps.

"Our navigation charts are getting stale. If you visit 3 systems I haven't had recent data from, I'll pay for the navigation data."

    Target system: sirius

--- First Haul [first_haul] (equipment, difficulty 1) ---
The salvage yard foreman needs someone to tow in a wreck. A good way to learn the business.
From: Yard Foreman Dak (Salvage Yard Supervisor)
"New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. Use `view_market` to find one on the exchange and `buy` to purchase it, or craft one yourself. Then use `install_mod` to fit it in a utility slot. Once equipped, fly to a wreck, use `tow_wreck` to attach it, then haul it back here. Use `sell_wreck` to cash it in. Simple as that."

"My workshop is backed up waiting on copper. If you can bring me 25 units of copper ore, I can get the production lines moving again."

Missions at Bench Home Station (8):
--- Local Sector Survey [local_sector_survey] (exploration, difficulty 2) ---
Chart nearby star systems to update our navigation databases. Every system you visit helps.
From: Cartographer Mbeki (Navigation Database Maintainer)
"Our navigation charts are getting stale. If you visit 3 systems I haven't had recent data from, I'll pay for the navigation data."
Rewards: 2,500cr, +30 exploration XP, +15 navigation XP
Objectives:
  - Visit the Sirius system
    Target system: sirius
  - Visit the Node Alpha system
    Target system: node_alpha
  - Visit the Horizon system
    Target system: horizon
--- First Haul [first_haul] (equipment, difficulty 1) ---
The salvage yard foreman needs someone to tow in a wreck. A good way to learn the business.
From: Yard Foreman Dak (Salvage Yard Supervisor)
"New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. Use `view_market` to find one on the exchange and `buy` to purchase it, or craft one yourself. Then use `install_mod` to fit it in a utility slot. Once equipped, fly to a wreck, use `tow_wreck` to attach it, then haul it back here. Use `sell_wreck` to cash it in. Simple as that."
Rewards: 500cr, +25 salvaging XP
Objectives:
  - Sell 1 wreck at a salvage yard
--- Copper Requisition [copper_requisition] (mining, difficulty 1) ---
Copper ore is essential for electronics manufacturing. Mine a batch for the station workshops.
From: Workshop Lead Tanaka (Chief Fabricator)
"My workshop is backed up waiting on copper. If you can bring me 25 units of copper ore, I can get the production lines moving again."
Rewards: 1,800cr, +15 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 25 units of Copper Ore
--- Market Participation: Selling [market_participation_selling] (trading, difficulty 1) ---
List items for sale on the station exchange. Any items count toward the goal.
From: Exchange Operator Nkosi (Market Services)
"The exchange needs sellers as much as buyers. List some items for sale - at least 10 units of anything. Use the `create_sell_order` command to put items on the market. There's a small listing fee, but the returns are worth it when buyers come knocking."
Rewards: 1,000cr, +15 trading XP
Objectives:
  - Sell 10 units of any item on the exchange
--- Titanium Extraction Contract [titanium_extraction_contract] (mining, difficulty 3) ---
Titanium is in high demand for hull plating. Mine a batch from the local asteroid belts.
From: Procurement Agent Vasquez (Materials Acquisition)
"Titanium prices are through the roof and our suppliers can't keep up. Willing to pay premium rates for 20 units of titanium ore."
Rewards: 3,500cr, +25 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 20 units of Titanium Ore

The salvage yard foreman needs someone to tow in a wreck. A good way to learn the business.
From: Yard Foreman Dak (Salvage Yard Supervisor)
"New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. Use `view_market` to find one on the exchange and `buy` to purchase it, or craft one yourself. Then use `install_mod` to fit it in a utility slot. --- First Haul [first_haul] (equipment, difficulty 1) ---
The salvage yard foreman needs someone to tow in a wreck. A good way to learn the business.
From: Yard Foreman Dak (Salvage Yard Supervisor)
"New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. Use `view_market` to find one on the exchange and `buy` to purchase it, or craft one yourself. Then use `install_mod` to fit it in a utility slot. Once equipped, fly to a wreck, use `tow_wreck` to attach it, then haul it back here. Use `sell_wreck` to cash it in. Simple as that."

Missions at Bench Home Station (8):
--- Titanium Extraction Contract [titanium_extraction_contract] (mining, difficulty 3) ---
Titanium is in high demand for hull plating. Mine a batch from the local asteroid belts.
From: Procurement Agent Vasquez (Materials Acquisition)
"Titanium prices are through the roof and our suppliers can't keep up. Willing to pay premium rates for 20 units of titanium ore."
Rewards: 3,500cr, +25 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 20 units of Titanium Ore
--- Iron Supply Run [iron_supply_run] (mining, difficulty 1) ---
The station needs a steady supply of iron ore to maintain its infrastructure. Mine some and bring it back.
From: Quartermaster Osei (Station Supply Officer)
"We're running low on iron ore again. If you can mine 30 units and bring them back, I'll make it worth your while."
Rewards: 1,500cr, +15 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 30 units of Iron Ore
--- Market Participation: Buying [market_participation_buying] (trading, difficulty 1) ---
Place buy orders on the station exchange to learn how the market works. Any items count.
From: Exchange Operator Nkosi (Market Services)
"The exchange runs on supply and demand, and right now we need more demand. Place some buy orders - any items, any quantity, as long as you buy at least 10 units total. Use the `create_buy_order` command to place an order on the book. Your orders sit there until a seller fills them, or you can cancel."
Rewards: 1,000cr, +15 trading XP
Objectives:
  - Buy 10 units of any item on the exchange
--- Pirate Bounty [pirate_bounty] (combat, difficulty 2) ---
Hunt down a pirate threatening local shipping lanes. Any pirate will do - the station pays for confirmed kills.
From: Bounty Clerk Frost (Station Security Office)
"We've got pirates disrupting trade in the region and the station is posting bounties. Take one out and bring proof. Use the `attack` command when you find one - pirates tend to spawn in lawless systems with low police presence. Fair warning: they shoot back, so watch your hull."
Rewards: 2,000cr, +20 weapons XP
Objectives:
  - Kill 1 pirate
--- Local Sector Survey [local_sector_survey] (exploration, difficulty 2) ---
Chart nearby star systems to update our navigation databases. Every system you visit helps.
From: Cartographer Mbeki (Navigation Database Maintainer)
"Our navigation charts are getting stale. If you visit 3 systems I haven't had recent data from, I'll pay for the navigation data."
Rewards: 2,500cr, +30 exploration XP, +15 navigation XP
Objectives:
  - Visit the Sirius system
    Target system: sirius
  - Visit the Node Alpha system
    Target system: node_alpha
  - Visit the Horizon system
    Target system: horizon
--- First Haul [first_haul] (equipment, difficulty 1) ---
The salvage yard foreman needs someone to tow in a wreck. A good way to learn the business.
From: Yard Foreman Dak (Salvage Yard Supervisor)
"New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. Use `view_market` to find one on the exchange and `buy` to purchase it, or craft one yourself. Then use `install_mod` to fit it in a utility slot. Once equipped, fly to a wreck, use `tow_wreck` to attach it, then haul it back here. Use `sell_wreck` to cash it in. Simple as that."
Rewards: 500cr, +25 salvaging XP
Objectives:
  - Sell 1 wreck at a salvage yard
--- Copper Requisition [copper_requisition] (mining, difficulty 1) ---
Copper ore is essential for electronics manufacturing. Mine a batch for the station workshops.
From: Workshop Lead Tanaka (Chief Fabricator)
"My workshop is backed up waiting on copper. If you can bring me 25 units of copper ore, I can get the production lines moving again."
Rewards: 1,800cr, +15 mining XP
Objectives:
  - Mine 25 units of Copper Ore
--- Market Participation: Selling [market_participation_selling] (trading, difficulty 1) ---
List items for sale on the station exchange. Any items count toward the goal.
From: Exchange Operator Nkosi (Market Services)
"The exchange needs sellers as much as buyers. List some items for sale - at least 10 units of anything. Use the `create_sell_order` command to put items on the market. There's a small listing fee, but the returns are worth it when buyers come knocking."
Rewards: 1,000cr, +15 trading XP
Objectives:
  - Sell 10 units of any item on the exchange
